title: Recommendation System Competition Platform
summary: A course competition platform, built on the Sim4Rec simulation framework, for designing and evaluating recommendation algorithms via multi-iteration revenue simulation. The vendored sim4rec/modules/generator.py imports CopulaGAN, CTGAN, GaussianCopula and TVAE from sdv.tabular to synthesize the user and item data driving the simulation, so SDV's tabular synthesizers arrive inherited through the bundled Sim4Rec library rather than being adopted directly by the student project.
evidence: sim4rec/modules/generator.py:12 'from sdv.tabular import CopulaGAN, CTGAN, GaussianCopula, TVAE'
needs: Unclear whether the student authors ever call these synthesizers directly, or only inherit them unused through the vendored Sim4Rec module set.
